components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00205b; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00205b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verdict Pill
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(0 32 91 / 0.1); color: #00205b; }

components.name: Fit Bar
components.html: 72/100
components.css: .ds-fit { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-fit__track { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fit__fill { height: 100%; background: #00205b; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-fit__value { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Post-session lab sheet: verdict and rule flags first, mono numerics for every rep, navy/red only for method state.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: Page background stays cool slate; no warm paper neutrals.

rules.name: The Code-Visible Rule
rules.body: Surface rule identifiers users can verify in src/lib/method/.

dos: Do use theme tokens and rule-backed labels.
Do keep Sha Tin and Kai Tak isolated per tab.
donts: Don't use Garmin VO2max as the primary story.
Don't use hero metrics or gradient text.
